message.content: In one of the discussions, Li Hua expressed interest in creating a little playlist for the kids, suggesting that classic lullabies and gentle guitar melodies would be suitable. Chae Song-hwa agreed enthusiastically, mentioning that creating a playlist would be fun and could help set a calming atmosphere for the children. He added that they could incorporate some of their band's mellow tunes into the playlist. Therefore, based on these conversations, Li Hua and Chae Song-hwa are considering including classic lullabies and gentle guitar melodies in their baby playlist. Additionally, they might introduce some of their own songs, which they believe could bring joy to the children.
